summary.text: Tiff Bluemle, a Democrat from Burlington, has represented Chittenden-13 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2021.
She is the ranking member of the House Committee on Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Bluemle began her career teaching high school history in New York after a year on the Mondale campaign, and she and her partner moved to Vermont in 1997, according to her House biography.
She served for seventeen years as executive director of Vermont Works for Women.
In 2007 she was appointed by the House Speaker to the Next Generation Commission, and in 2015 she led Change The Story VT, a collaboration to advance women's economic well-being.

She has served on the boards of Princeton University, Vermont Energy Investment Corporation and the Vermont Council on Rural Development, and she most recently chaired the board of Public Assets Institute.
